# Meddleware

> Permissionless, wallet-based tools for Sui and Walrus: storage, sealed (encrypted) storage, NFT-gated access passes, token issuance and an organisation treasury view. No accounts; you connect a Sui wallet.

Address: https://meddleware.co.uk

## Tools

- [Dashboard (all tools in one place)](https://dash.meddleware.co.uk)
- [Walrus Storage](https://sui-walrus-storage.meddleware.co.uk)
- [Sealed Storage](https://sui-sealed-storage.meddleware.co.uk)
- [Access Gate](https://sui-access-gate.meddleware.co.uk)
- [Token Issuance](https://sui-token-issuance.meddleware.co.uk)
- [Treasury](https://treasury.meddleware.co.uk)
- [Status](https://status.meddleware.co.uk)
